acceptanceCriteria: The ps observation budgets in the PUB-V0-026 POSIX fixture are long enough to survive host load and shorter than the fixture child's 60 s lifetime.
The PUB-V0-026 cancellation and cleanup bounds are unchanged.
body: TestPUBV0026InterruptedInstallReapsDescendant gives processidentity.Start (a ps call) one second at internal/releasecandidate/operations_posix_test.go:63 and in its cleanup at :44; assertFixtureProcessGone gives ps two seconds at operations_test.go:256. At host load ~450 the ps child was killed at the deadline and the package failed with 'fixture identity unavailable: process start-time observation unavailable: signal: killed' (2026-09-26, claude/srr-v1-012-readiness-command after merging main). The fixture child sleeps 60 s, so the observation budgets are not product bounds.
title: PUB-V0-026 interruption fixture fails under load: 1 s process-identity deadline
